# ASCII 游戏素材与灵感库 / ASCII Game Library

- [Tidebound research handoff](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Yihancheng0/ascii-game-library/main/ideas/tidebound-research-handoff.md): confirmed D-10 directions, current runtime, unresolved defects, references, verification boundaries and research-only initial scope for a new thread.

- [Tidebound production framework](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Yihancheng0/ascii-game-library/main/ideas/tidebound-framework/README.md): current draft 1.0.0-draft.1, role-based reading routes, 13 chapters, rules, object specs, calibration states and evidence gates. Documentation only; runtime stays v0.6.1. Do not treat proposed systems or pending visual baselines as implemented or accepted.
> 中文开发参考、双语标签、可读源码、逐项授权来源。Updated: 2026-10-20.

- [Start here](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Yihancheng0/ascii-game-library/main/START_HERE.md): AI retrieval procedure and examples.
- [Resource catalog](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Yihancheng0/ascii-game-library/main/catalog/resources.json): 12 games, tools, libraries and collections.
- [Category index](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Yihancheng0/ascii-game-library/main/catalog/categories.json): 24 categories; fetch one shard after choosing a category.
- [Manifest](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Yihancheng0/ascii-game-library/main/catalog/manifest.json): source revision and coverage.
- [All animation metadata](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Yihancheng0/ascii-game-library/main/catalog/ascii-magic.json): 734 entries; prefer category shards to save context.
- [Full combined JSON](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Yihancheng0/ascii-game-library/main/catalog/catalog.json): all machine-readable metadata.
- [Text digest](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Yihancheng0/ascii-game-library/main/llms-full.txt): compact one-line-per-piece text index.
- [Recipes](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Yihancheng0/ascii-game-library/main/docs/recipes.md): game-oriented search routes and design prompts.
- [Reuse](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Yihancheng0/ascii-game-library/main/docs/reuse-guide.md): distinguish inspiration, code and reusable art.
- [Source snapshot](https://github.com/Yihancheng0/ascii-game-library/tree/main/vendor/ascii-magic-art): 634 pinned modules, runtime and toolkit with notices.
- [Design ideas index](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Yihancheng0/ascii-game-library/main/catalog/design-ideas.json): searchable project ideas, user worldbuilding and game reference notes; status does not imply implementation.
- [Design notebook](https://github.com/Yihancheng0/ascii-game-library/blob/main/ideas/README.md): fish-world rules, giant-fish towing, ability combinations and creative methods.
- [60 fish designs](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Yihancheng0/ascii-game-library/main/catalog/fish-species.json): original candidate abilities, conditions, costs, counters and visual notes; not implemented features.
- [15 three-fish builds](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Yihancheng0/ascii-game-library/main/catalog/fish-combinations.json): composition sequences, emergent choices, failure cases, dangerous symbioses and small validation ideas.
- [24 fish interactions](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Yihancheng0/ascii-game-library/main/catalog/fish-interactions.json): pair synergies, conflicts, counters and invalid shortcuts.

Game implementation handoff: projects/tidebound/README.md and projects/tidebound/versions.json. Original story: ideas/tidebound-story.md. Art/weather adaptation: ideas/tidebound-art.md. Actual private code versions are separate from candidate design notes.
